about_the_game:
Overview

In Esper Agent, you are an elite operative from a clandestine agency of psychic girls. A mission of the highest priority has come down: Infiltrate a metropolis ruled by a mega-corporation and stop a sinister plot that threatens the world.

Esper Agent is a fast-paced, side-scrolling roguelite shooter. Choose your agent and dive into the fray, combining psychic powers, powerful weapons, and genetic enhancements to crush your enemies. Your strategic choices in routes and resource management will determine the success of your mission.

High-Speed Side-Scrolling Shooter

Experience fluid and intense bullet-hell combat. You'll need to master your arsenal of weapons and unique skills to survive. Strategic ammo and reload management is crucial to gaining the upper hand in battle.

Deep Build Customization

Forge an agent that fits your unique playstyle. Modify your weapons with "Parts," enhancing their stats and effects through upgrades and synthesis. As an Esper, you can also unlock your latent potential with "Gene Mods" to augment your agent's core abilities. Combine these elements with a variety of psychic powers to become the ultimate operative.

Strategic Infiltration Ops

Every choice matters. The infiltration route you take will affect the rewards you gain and the enemies you challenge. Carefully weigh your options to meet the needs of your current build and successfully complete your mission by defeating the final boss and thwarting the conspiracy.

Tech R&D

Back at headquarters, use the "Agent Points" collected from your missions to invest in Research & Development. Unlock powerful new functions and even recruit new Esper agents to join your cause.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 32/64bit or greater
  • Processor: 3.4 GHz Dual Core Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX650 or greater
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: As a Esper agent, infiltrate from the outskirts to the city center and defeat the final boss to stop the conspiracy. Strengthen yourself with genetic enhancements and parts, and master your weapons and superpowers to succeed.
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean
